notes.title: Patch #2 - A few bug fixes
notes.content:
*One upgrade said “On slime kill:” while all other said “On slime death:” This has been corrected.
*Fixed a bug where the arrows that point to the tutorial text would overlap the text if the Japanese or Russian language was chosen.
*Fixed a bug where the size of the Spiky Shield would be really big. The size increase after upgrading the spiky shield would not reset, which means every time you upgrade it, the size would be saved from the last run.

notes.title: Patch #1 - Balancing
notes.content:
*Changes the trigger chance of a few “On slime click/death” upgrades.
*Increased the Saw Blade start damage from 3 to 4. Also slightly increased the size.
*Increased the Boulder start damage from 4 to 5. 
*Increased the Cursor Slash start damage from 1 to 1,4.
*Increased the Stabby Knife start damage from 7 to 8. 
*Increased the Paper Shot start damage from 8 to 9.
*Increased the Poison Dart poison increase when upgraded from 0.2 to 0.4 This means that the total poison damage will deal 1.6 damage more each time it is upgraded.
*Increased the Spiky Shield damage from 3 to 4.
*Decreased the Anvil start damage from 9 to 8.
*Made a lot of waves on the Normal and Hard gamemodes SLIGHTLY easier.

notes.title: Demo Patch #3 - Small changes
notes.content:
*Fixed a bug where both the lose and win screen would appear if you die on wave 25.
*Made the fast slimes slightly bigger, now they are easier to click.
*A few waves spawns a few less slimes.

notes.title: Demo Patch #2 - Balance & bug fixes
notes.content:
*Fixed a bug where the stapler shoot time upgrade text would display 5+ decimal points.
*Fixed a bug where the shadow of a projectile had a chance to not disappear after colliding with a slime.
*Bug fix: When a stapler got stuck to a slime, it had a chance to weirdly blink and spawn super fast around the screen.
*Bug fix: Slimes would sometimes spawn 2 slime goo after being squished. Slime goo also had a chance to be the wrong color.
*BUG FIX: The laser flash would spawn in the wrong position.

*Made a few adjustments on projectile colliders.
*Balance: Removed a few slimes from each wave after wave 11.

notes.title: Demo Patch #1 - Balance & bug fixes
notes.content:
*Increased the “DEATH TO SLIMES” kill count to 7 and wave recharge down to 3.
*Made the click collider slightly bigger.
*Made all waves from 7 and up slightly easier.
*Slightly increased the size of the small fast slimes. Also slightly decreased the speed.
*Slightly lowered the speed of all slime bullets. Also decreased how often they shoot.
*Decreased the starting click cooldown time down from 0.81 sec to 0.75. Also made the click cooldown upgrade better.

Bug fix: The wrong background was set when first playing the game.
Bug fix: The challenge hover icon had a chance to mess up and constantly play sound effects.
